run_checkpoint_evaluation: run a PyTorch checkpoint evaluation on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, or MNIST test datasets
run_wideresnet_evaluation: run a WideResNet model evaluation on a test dataset with configurable depth and width
run_preactresnet_evaluation: run a PreActResNet model evaluation by setting width to zero and specifying depth
run_mnist_evaluation: run a model evaluation on the MNIST dataset with single channel input and padding
run_partial_evaluation: run evaluation on a limited number of batches using the num_batches flag
